title: Summoning demonstrations for the AARO director

tellings.quote: We're doing demonstrations for the new director of Arrow. They're fully privy. They've seen our videos.

plain: A private team says it is showing the new head of the Pentagon's UFO office, known as AARO, how it calls up unexplained craft. Jake Barber, a former helicopter pilot who says he once carried away a UFO, describes it from inside the effort: "We're doing demonstrations for the new director," he says, adding that the office is "fully privy" and has "seen our videos." If true, it would mean the government is watching attempts to summon these objects on purpose.
